title: Franca interface strings (strings/<name>.yaml)
description: Interface text in the pack's language. There are names for interface elements, messages in ICU MessageFormat and a glossary of grammar terms. The messages are checked against the English catalogue, key by key, by the pack builder (story E03-002). Imported into catalogue_element_name_v, catalogue_ui_string_v and catalogue_glossary_v.

element_names.description: The names of interface elements in the pack's language, by element key.

strings.description: Interface messages in ICU MessageFormat, by string key.
